children.name: Text
children.characters: Start new GUI elements and mockups here. Everything is built from the app's real tokens (tailwind.css, ui/styles.js).

children.name: Text
children.characters: 1. Open this file, then import the matching .variables.json (collection "RecoveryBot", modes Light and Dark). Switch a frame's mode to preview dark.

children.name: Text
children.characters: 2. Duplicate a frame from Mockups (desktop HostDeck, blank desktop, phone) and design inside it. Keep the header and bottom bar.

children.name: Text
children.characters: 3. Reuse Components (buttons, input, select, pills, card, rows, tabs, section mark, Topicificator mini). Bind new fills to variables, not hex values.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Accent blue (#0b6ede) is for the primary action, links and the selected item. Everything else is neutral.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Controls and rows: radius 12. Cards: 16. Big panels: 20. Chips and badges: fully round. Cards float with a soft shadow (0 4 12, 10% black).

children.name: Text
children.characters: Type: TikTok Sans for titles, Figtree for everything else. Small uppercase labels (12, semibold, wide tracking, muted) name each group of controls.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Buttons are 36 high with a 14px label. One primary button per area; the rest are quiet (white, hairline ring) or danger (text only).

children.name: Text
children.characters: Layout: header 57, sidebars 272 and 352, bottom bar 64. On phones one column at a time under tabs, with a 16px gutter and no horizontal scroll.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Both themes always: light page is #fafafa with white surfaces; dark page is #0a0a0a with #171717 surfaces. Check every mockup in both.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Accessible: 4.5:1 text contrast, visible focus ring (2px accent), tap targets at least 36px, never color alone for state.

children.name: Body
children.characters: Body: Figtree 400 / 14, line 1.45. Used for forms, lists and most UI. Editors (events, groups) use Public Sans.

children.name: Label
children.characters: LABEL: FIGTREE 600 / 12, UPPERCASE, TRACKING WIDE, MUTED
